title: Media Alert: Leaders Gather at GROUNDBREAKERS™ 2025
summary: Forum looks at how AI, infrastructure and energy are changing global logistics LOS ANGELES, Sept. 23, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Prologis presents its annual thought leadership forum, GROUNDBREAKERS™ 2025
body_markdown:
*Forum looks at how AI, infrastructure and energy are changing global logistics*


LOS ANGELES


, Sept. 23, 2025


/PRNewswire/ -- Prologis presents its annual thought leadership forum,[GROUNDBREAKERS™ 2025](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4516242-1&h=615989241&u=https%3A%2F%2Fgroundbreakers.prologis.com%2F&a=GROUNDBREAKERS%E2%84%A2%C2%A02025) , a one‑day event that brings together business leaders, policymakers and innovators on major issues shaping the global supply chain. At a time when geopolitical and trade policy changes are resetting business strategies, GROUNDBREAKERS will explore top-of-mind topics critical to the movement of goods and growth of business.


**WHEN** : Tuesday, September 30


: 12:00 PM ET - 6:30 PM ET


( 9:00 AM PT


– 3:30 PM PT


)


**WHERE** : Los Angeles, CA


( Hollywood


area)
